subject: maths
question: The compound interest received on Rs. 18,000 for 2 years is Rs. 7,920, when the interest is compounded annually. What is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
Given:

The compound interest accrued on Rs. 18000 in two years is Rs. 7920.

Formula Used:

C.I = Principal × ((1 + r/100)t - 1);

Calculation:

⇒ 7920 = 18000 × ((1 + r/100)2 - 1)

⇒ 7920/18000 = ((1 + r/100)2 - 1)

⇒ 11/25 + 1 = (1 + r/100)2

⇒ 36/25 = (1 + r/100)²

Take root both sides

⇒ 6/5 = (1 + r/100)

⇒ r/100 = 1/5

⇒ r = 20

∴ required rate of interest = 20%

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
